name: Cloudflare homepage — orange brand-block landing page by cloudflare.com
description: The page opens with a full-bleed, heavily rounded brand-orange hero panel — event pill, oversized two-line headline, one white pill CTA and a glowing horizon — then settles onto a white canvas where airy centred display statements alternate with dense proof modules: a halftone-dot globe card, a tabbed logo wall with testimonial, a bordered four-column pricing grid, and fake product-UI mockups (a deployment version table, an agent terminal). After the hero, orange is rationed to micro-accents — active tabs, "Deployed" badges, line icons — so the closing orange CTA band lands with the same visual weight as the opening. Thin 1px borders, flat shadows, a single geometric sans and a dense multi-column footer keep the enterprise scale readable.
